title: WS-048 - Interpret complex table XML in result exports
intent: Explain how Complex Table elements and cell values are represented in EUSurvey XML exports.
short_answer: A Complex Table is represented by a ComplexTableTitle and one Cell element for each non-empty cell. Each Cell can contain CellTitle and ResultText. Answers link to the corresponding cell using qid. For Single Choice and Multiple Choice cells, answers also use aid for the selected option. For Free Text, Number or Formula cells, the value is contained as text in the Answer element.
procedure: Read ComplexTableTitle to identify the complex table.
Read Cell elements to identify non-empty cells and their cell type, row and column.
Use CellTitle and ResultText to map labels shown in results.
For each Answer, use qid to match the cell.
For choice-type cells, use aid to identify the selected answer option.
For text, number or formula cells, read the answer text directly.
important_conditions: Empty cells are not represented as Cell elements.
The annex example contains every possible complex-table cell type once, including static text, free text, formula, single choice, multiple choice and number.
